'''Jeelta Urdosh''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was one of the heads of each of the [[Three Families]] on [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Jeelta, along with [[Portho Kaltemmic]] and [[Broga Masrii]], formed the [[Three Families]] and broke away from the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] to support the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by providing them with combat adrenals process from [[Quesh]] venom.<ref name="TTF" />

In [[3642 BBY]], Jeelta discovered that Portho had betrayed the Three Families to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. But before he could punish the traitor, a group of Imperial heroes stormed their palace. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Berin Fraal]], who was communicating via hologram, ordered Jeelta to take the intruders prisoner and deliver them to him. Jeelta then quickly hid behind a ray shield while his enforcers and droids attempted to subdue the Imperials, but they were all felled, before the Imperials overloaded the shield generators, electrocuting Jeelta, killing him.<ref name="TTF" />
